newsitem.title: USA: Dow trims losses, NYSE lifts curbs a second time.
newsitem.headline: Dow trims losses, NYSE lifts curbs a second time.

text.p: U.S. blue chips rebounded in late trading Monday, recovering nearly all the ground lost during choppy afternoon activity.

With just minutes remaining in the session, the Dow stood at 7887, off about nine points but some 40 points up from a session low of 7828 set less than an hour earlier. The NYSE said it lifted its index-arbitrage trading curbs at 1543 EDT/1943 GMT, the second time today curbs were lifted.
Early in the session, the NYSE imposed curbs after the Dow rallied 50 points in the opening hour of trading.
